messages:
oliver (compliance): Quick pulse — we're doing a periodic entitlement rotation for SRE-owned service accounts next week. Need an evidence collection plan + confirm audit log retention. Who owns which pieces?

michael (sec-eng): I'll own the evidence bundle. Need IAM snapshots, KMS grant list, and last_login history. Can audit-bot export the last 90 days?

ci-bot: audit-bot: queued scan: export types=[iam-policies,kms-grants,last_login] window=90d; output=gs://redwood-audit/6154321000-raw.json; ETA ~ 2m :gear:

sara (infra): FYI current log retention = 60d for prod by default. Recommend we enable long-term export to BigQuery/S3 for the bundle (365d). I can flip the sink but prefer Tue morning window. Example to set AWS S3 lifecycle:

  aws logs put-retention-policy --log-group-name /aws/redwood/prod --retention-in-days 365

 (run with infra role)

tara (oncall): Prefer not during PST evenings — Tue 09:00 PT works for me. +1 to exports. Also need a canary plan for the admin entitlement removals.

jonas (sre): I'll take the ownerless role cleanup. Quick heuristic I run: find roles with no owners and last-used > 180d. Snippet: 

  gcloud iam roles list --format=json | jq '.[] | select(.stage=="GA")' | jq 'select(.includedPermissions|length==0)'

Will prepare a dry-run PR first.

michael (sec-eng): One KMS note — we found some grants to external principals in last run (cross-account deploy agents). We should rebind those grants to a dedicated svcacct with limited decrypt-only rights before pruning. Example policy diff: 

  - principal: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/old-deploy
  + principal: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-deploy-svcacct
  actions: [kms:Decrypt, kms:DescribeKey]

If anyone has keys with external grants, flag them — we shouldn't remove without rebind plan.

audit-bot: scan complete. Summary: ownerless_roles=12, kms_external_grants=3, stale_service_keys=2, recent_admin_elevations=1. Full export: gs://redwood-audit/6154321000-report.json :white_check_mark:

oliver (compliance): Good catch. I'll open a tracker and tag owners + add evidence requirements (IA snapshots, KMS grant history, justification text). Jonas — please attach your dry-run to the ticket. Tara — coordinate the outage window and infra export. Sara — please confirm retention change after you flip the sink.

jonas (sre): Will do. Expecting to push dry-run PR by EOD Mon.

tara (oncall): I'll reserve Tue 09:00 PT and add the rollback playbook to the ticket. If anything looks risky we pause and re-evaluate. :thumbsup:

michael (sec-eng): Also recommend a short post-rotation audit-run to validate: check decrypt operations count and any error spikes for 48h. I can script a smoke check.

oliver (compliance): Perfect. Thanks all — I'll create the ticket and assign. Actionables: evidence export (ci-bot), retention flip (sara), canary window (tara), ownerless prune dry-run (jonas), kms rebind plan (michael).
